footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes an $8.1M income tax benefit.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 28, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 13.1% to $3.0B in 2025 (ended Dec 28, 2025). Gross margin was 8.3%, versus 8.4% a year earlier, and operating income rose 7.0% to $92.8M, a 3.1% margin.
Net income was $22.4M, or $0.25 per share, after a $6.7M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $78.1M and free cash flow −$8.2M, versus $58.9M.
watch: Net income includes a $8.1M tax benefit.
sources: Centuri Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
